name: Publish
description: This workspace's web pages: get a page's link and chat card, list the pages (no arguments), copy a file or folder into /public/<slug>, or remove a page. Anything in /public is live at once: /public/<name>/index.html is https://…:8447/<this workspace>/<name>/. Inline CSS works, and inline and same-folder scripts run in a sandbox: no storage, no fetch, no forms, popups or alerts, nothing from other hosts. Tell the user what a page's scripts do and ask before publishing one.
author: anything

examples.prompt: Put the trip plan on a page I can open on my phone
Take the trip plan page down

path.description: A file or folder to copy into /public/<slug> (e.g. '/work/report', '/project/chart.png'), or a page already in /public.

slug.description: The page's name in its URL: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

remove.description: true to take the page at slug (or path) off the web.
